topic: Applicant withdrawal while issuance may remain active
observedProblem: Organization withdrawal unconditionally changed approved, offered and credentialed applications to WITHDRAWN while leaving issuance tokens and credentials untouched.
A reserved Flow request could remain in flight while organization withdrawal masked its application; applying the eventual offer then failed at the application boundary.
An early or previously withdrawn application carrying retained or uncertain issuance data could also be accepted by the self-service withdrawal path.

contractReview.contractPromises: Withdrawal decisions and fail_closed behavior; no token cancellation or credential revocation guarantee.
contractReview.legacyPythonApplicantRuntime: Removed by existing native cutover; historical Python implementation unavailable in this shallow base.

implementation.approvedBoundary: Approval commits an application.approved event; absence of a returned offer is not proof that issuance has not started.
implementation.blockedEvidence: Offer/claim state, issued_at, an active attempt, or retained/nonempty issuance transaction, attempt, Flow, offer, expiry or issuance status data. Malformed non-null bindings are refused.
implementation.denialDetail: Issuance must be reconciled before withdrawing this application
